notes.title: Happy New Year and Hello!
notes.content:
Development is in full swing!

Hey guys! We're excited to share the latest development and progress news with you, so add the game to your WishList to stay updated. Currently, we are working on and brainstorming tower interaction mechanics in the game, their skills, and special abilities:

 Spell attacks
 Auras (acting on an area)
 Impact effects of abilities
 Triggers like Death Rattle and others
 Various healing abilities, Buffs/Debuffs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297187/2cb0f57443d332b60d30d90962bf3deb1654fd94.png
[previewyoutube=Lsn_LLU_uj8;full][/previewyoutube]

Enhanced Items Acquisition System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297187/9fbc039c88c129c5b782d01bae3de6820f4152db.png
We've introduced a mechanic that allows you to get loot boxes with in-game valuables for a certain amount of in-game currency - currently, these are avatars that provide different bonuses for your towers in the game. In the future, this mechanism will be one of the main ways to acquire in-game valuables for in-game currency.

Global Chat and Communication
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297187/5c07db2624e998ff52b6e5f46f40b85411ef5b9e.png
A global chat has been added to the lobby of the game where you can communicate, discuss tactics, battle outcomes, and more. Additionally, the chat includes a feature to track players' status:

 Simply in the lobby
 Currently seeking an opponent
 Already engaged in a battle

These statuses enable you to receive information about the actions of a player without having to message them directly.
